title: Metric–measure universality of subcritical FK and tree-weighted maps
exact_target: For each fixed $q\in (0,4)$ in the stated spherical FK map ensemble, and separately for the spanning-tree-weighted ensemble, is there a deterministic $a_n\to 0$ such that the graph metric multiplied by $a_n$ and the specified probability measure converge through all n to the corresponding unit-area Liouville quantum sphere in Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov law? The root and map decoration are forgotten.
